observations: The right lower storey now contains a partly hidden arched entrance, a narrow arched window, a double rectangular window group and a triple rectangular window group. Seven separate wall apertures, recessed solid glazing, divided window frames, transoms, sills and hoods replace the prior generic opening layout in bays 17-19.

The entrance fanlight has concentric rails and radial dividers. Two solid door leaves include lower panels, stile/rail geometry, narrow diamond-like grille segments and pull handles. Three treads meet the lowered interior floor; a closed foundation supports the lowest tread. Door pose and unseen portions remain inferred.

The first double-window transom includes a small solid fan rim, recessed disc and five blades. Facade piers and capitals have depth, with small recessed-looking dark groove strips; fine weathering remains approximate.

The initial native render exposed a wide blurred stripe through the rightmost window. It came from an early foreground-steel exclusion mask, rather than from the new wall geometry. A new isolated surface atlas restores 13175 visible source pixels in this mistakenly excluded region using the same color grading. All pixels outside the patch are unchanged, and original materials/images are preserved.

The old bay-17 floor slab contributed 232 removed triangles; 16180 boundary-candidate triangles were clipped against the explicit replacement volumes, producing 2131 retained fragments. Every unaffected original triangle position and UV is preserved after saving and reopening.

195 closed solids contain 24900 new triangles. Saved/reopened coordinates, manifold edges and positive volume were verified. Forty-two probes verify unobstructed structural openings; nine verify the new interior floor height and nine verify the lowest-tread foundation contact.

The full front, cropped detail, close oblique, full opposite-side oblique and equal-resolution reference/before/after comparison were inspected. This is an incremental reconstruction, not a one-to-one result. The still-generic right upper arcade, large foreground leaves, equipment boxes, umbrella and retaining band remain visibly different.

Movie and night scenes, shared node groups and unaffected poster geometry/materials/camera/lighting remain unchanged. The 23 existing packed images retain their bytes; the restored right atlas is one additional packed image.

Native positions, normals and UVs match the exported data, previous geometry/material instances and all surviving original ivy matrices/colors remain unchanged, and the new right paint uses an isolated texture. Thirty-five HTTP resources match local bytes. Browser/GPU display remains unverified; the latest actual connection attempt was the v53 timeout.
